gen-dafont-junegull-plus-jakarta-sans: Junegull has a retro, friendly look, with pinched curve mouths and a lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals. Plus Jakarta Sans follows in a sans-serif monoline, its curve endings kept well apart and its lowercase lower.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-bitter: Wide, loose tracking and a rolling-ball pen line give Lemon Milk its neon-tube look, with every stroke the same width. Bitter, a slab-serif, grounds it below.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-fs-chillax: Lemon Milk spreads out wide and loose, drawn with one rolling-ball line and rounded, inviting letters. Chillax, a sans-serif, loosens up below it, so the heading can run bigger than the body text.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-fs-roundo: Striking and friendly, Lemon Milk sprawls in wide tracking with one rolling-ball line and a tall lowercase. Roundo keeps the small counters unclogged.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-cambo: Strokes pulled like solder through a nozzle, spaced wide and loose, make Lemon Milk instantly recognisable on sight. Cambo adds a refined, bookish shimmer of weight.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-manuale: Friendly and striking, Lemon Milk sets its brush-like fixed-width line in wide, loose tracking. Manuale, a classic serif, adds editorial tradition with a large-eyed lowercase and moderate contrast.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-naskh-arab: Friendly and striking, Lemon Milk lays down wide, loose letters with no thick-to-thin shading at all. Noto Naskh Arabic, a classic serif, adds refined engraved-brass contrast and a very tall x-height.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-nastaliq-u: Noto Nastaliq Urdu is editorial and dignified, with a tight vertical rhythm and barely any ascenders. Lemon Milk, with its rounded, wide-set strokes, would overpower it if the heading were made small.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-rashi-hebr: Noto Rashi Hebrew is classic and bookish, with lightly engraved contrast. Lemon Milk grabs attention with wide, friendly, constant-width strokes, while the classic serif body carries a faint thick-thin shift with short ascenders.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-serif-ahom: Noto Serif Ahom is traditional and dignified, with a lofty lowercase and joins that taper modestly. And Lemon Milk sits above it in wide, friendly, constant-weight letters.
